study_identification_part.si_4_title: Extreme deviations from the normative model reveal cortical heterogeneity and associations with negative symptom severity in /uniFB01 rst-episode psychosis from the OPTiMiSE and GAP studies

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Federated hierarchical Bayesian regression reference normative model.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we used one of the largest ( n = ~40,000) reference normative models available, built using a federated, hierarchical Bayesian regression approach across a population of multi-site MRI data

nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: For each of the 148 regions of the Destrieux atlas, cortical thickness was calculated and extracted.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Cortical thickness predicted from age; sex and scanner site included as batch effects.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We used a pre-estimated multi-site reference normative model predicting cortical thickness from age.; Participant sex and scanner site have been accounted for in the model by inclusion as batch effects
